_comment: Game/CPU-specific addresses for mame-mcp validation (Shinobi, MAME 0.289). Test fixture data only: the server contains none of these.

maincpu.handler_note: 68000 level-4 autovector target; hit about every frame (vector table 0x70)

multi_location.note: 68000 level-4 handler path (disassembled with MAME's own dasm): 0x404 bra $286C; 0x286C movem.l; 0x2870 tst.b $F01E.w; 0x2874 bne. Every interrupt executes all of them, so a location at 0x404 / 0x2870 has an independent MAME-debugger observer at the neighbouring instruction (0x286C / 0x2874).

locations.observer_sr_note: tst.b between them changes the condition codes, so SR is not compared

soundcpu.hot_note: idle loop 0xAE4..0xAEA, found by sampling PC 120 times on this ROM set (scripts note: runs/zprobe)
soundcpu.observer_note: idle loop 0xAE4 in a,(1) / 0xAE6 bit 0,a (CB 47) / 0xAE8 jr z,0xAE4 (bytes read from ROM). The observer breakpoint sits on 0xAE8, the instruction after the capture address; bit 0,a only writes F, so SP/BC/HL read at the observer equal their values at the hit.

explicit_cpu_qualification.note: program byte 0 differs between the CPUs (68000 vector table vs Z80 reset code); the test compares bridge output to MAME's own debugger per CPU and requires the two CPUs to differ

read_tap.note: 68000 vector-table entry (bus-error/address-error vectors): ROM, not read by normal execution, so tap calls come only from the test's reads
